description: This file defines the interface for screen capture functionality within the WPEFramework Exchange namespace. It declares the ICapture interface with methods for capturing data and retrieving its name, along with a nested IStore interface for storing captured image data.

classes.name: ICapture
classes.description: A virtual interface for capturing screen data, providing methods to get the name, perform capture, and access an instance of the capture interface.

classes.name: ICapture::IStore
classes.description: An interface for storing image data received from the capture process, with a method to handle RGBA pixel buffers.

methods.name: ICapture::Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the capture instance.

methods.name: ICapture::Capture
methods.description: Performs the screen capture and stores the data using the provided IStore instance.

methods.name: ICapture::Instance
methods.description: Static method to retrieve the singleton instance of the ICapture interface.

methods.name: IStore::~IStore
methods.description: Virtual destructor for the IStore interface.

methods.name: IStore::R8_G8_B8_A8
methods.description: Stores RGBA pixel data from a buffer for a specified width and height.

ctags.name: ICapture
ctags.pattern: /^    struct EXTERNAL ICapture : virtual public Core::IUnknown {$/
